correctness.rationale: The square sequence starts at C4, then glues each new C4 exactly along an existing edge or two-edge path. The recursion tests all edges and neighbor pairs; exact graph isomorphism after Weisfeiler–Lehman prescreen removes duplicates, and cycle rank equals number of added squares. Graphs remain bipartite, so every 7-set contains an independent 4-set and the four-robust clique complex has faces only up to size 6. Each face is tested directly against all independent 4-subsets. The inspected verifier builds greedy matched edges for every face, enumerates every oriented Hasse incidence and verifies acyclicity, leaving one critical zero-cell and only dimension-five cells. Independently reran the entire graph-generation, face-enumeration and acyclic matching census for all 1,628 isomorphism classes in approximately 21 seconds: levels [1,2,7,29,179,1410], face totals [15,94,1032,10617,136973,1968168], level Betti sums [0,0,3,60,1098,19210], level6 positive classes 1396 and max beta 20, and 9,103,719 directed Hasse incidences total. Separately decoded all 1,628 rows of actual census.csv and checked aggregates. These complete finite checks prove the explicitly bounded six-square classification, not any infinite-length conjecture.
